note: Reset entry, not-reset and the first control-class rows. Every expect value is read from the cited page image and derived by hand; none comes from this core, an assembler or another implementation.

vectors.cite: Initialization sequence figure, pdf 27; first instruction after reset runs, pdf 22
vectors.derivation: The initialization figure (pdf 27) starts counting at the MSYNC release: microcycle 0 is NACT, microcycle 1 is IAB (input starting program counter), microcycles 2 to 4 are NACT and the first BAR (output starting program counter) is in microcycle 5. So the reset entry unit is 5 cycles with one IAB access at offset 1. POL-RST-01: reset zero-fills R0-R7 and the status flags and clears INTFF; the IAB reply loads all 16 bits of R7, here the provider answers $0000 so R7 = $0000; R0-R6 stay 0 from the zero-fill (init values 1111..7777 are overwritten, status S and C and INTFF go from 1 to 0). The first instruction after the entry always runs (pdf 22), so prev_interruptible = 0. Run state goes RESET_PENDING -> RUNNING.
